pipeline_traces.provenance: attached files verified byte-identical to runs_local/lme_final_controller_v12_qwen_180/controller/ (SHA-256 prefix match on action_log, judgments, judge_cache)

answer.latency_semantics: predictions.latency_ms is CUMULATIVE end-to-end per item (includes upstream extraction+relation), NOT answer-generation time. Implied generation-only time = 40.46h - 38.91h = 1.55h = 31.0 s/item.

caches.note: cache dedup <0.3%; near-zero reuse because each turn/candidate context is unique

abstention_split.note: 9 sessions carry an _abs suffix and are unanswerable by design; 'correct' on those means correctly declining. Over-refusal is detected by the scorer's [refusal-guard] rationale on ANSWERABLE items.

ingestion_finding.interpretation: B3 recency runs a MORE expensive extraction stage than the governed controller (43.0M vs 41.8M prompt tokens) and scores 23.9% against 76.1%. Extraction is the dominant and largely shared cost; the governance machinery (relation classification) is a +26% marginal increment on extraction that accounts for the +52.2-point gap. The 'expensive governance' framing is therefore wrong: what is expensive is ingestion, which every write-time system pays.
ingestion_finding.total_cost_disclosure: ASK has the LARGEST total prompt cost (56.8M vs B3's 43.2M) because it is the only system running both extraction and relation. The finding is NOT that ASK is cheaper overall; it is that B3's extraction stage alone (43.0M) exceeds ASK's extraction (41.8M) while scoring 23.9% vs 76.1%, so extraction is the dominant shared cost and governance is a 26% increment on it.

component_design.structure: 3 dialogue lengths (9/11/13 turns) x 3 gold actions (KEEP/SUPERSEDE/ABSTAIN)
component_design.verified_component_action_balance: 40/40 groups are exactly 3 KEEP / 3 SUPERSEDE / 3 ABSTAIN
component_design.verified_length_action_balance: each dialogue length is exactly 40 KEEP / 40 SUPERSEDE / 40 ABSTAIN
component_design.shared_standing_value: all 9 items in a component share one principal, memory_slot, and standing_value
component_design.shared_candidate_value: all 9 items propose the same candidate value
component_design.identical_evidence_pool: 120/120 (length, component) triples share a byte-identical 6-sentence evidence pool
component_design.label_mechanism: the 3 actions differ ONLY in which 2 of the 6 pooled sentences the dialogue indexes to the target slot; the 3 indexed pairs exactly partition the 6-sentence pool (verified 80/80 parseable triples, all distinct, all partitioning)

shortcut_audit.probes: word TF-IDF + logistic regression over 12 restricted text views; char TF-IDF over 2 views; punctuation-only and length-only numeric features; decision trees at depths 1-5
shortcut_audit.fit_protocol: fitted on TRAIN, evaluated on HIDDEN, component-held-out
shortcut_audit.result: failed_gates = [] (all probes at or below threshold)

duplicate_audit.exact: SHA-256 over 7 restricted views; gate fails on ANY cross-split collision in full_text, dialogue_only, candidate_only, previous_turn, last_two
duplicate_audit.near: char TF-IDF (4-6 grams) cosine >= 0.995 on full text, cross-split only

hard_checks: content_hash must match the coordinator binding
evidence_turn_ids must be non-empty and reference real turns
annotation_validation.provenance_limit: builder validates records, hashes, and owner attestation; does NOT authenticate reviewer identity or annotation duration

error_mechanism_test.description: For each dev error by the frozen controller, locate the sibling item (same component, same dialogue length) whose gold action equals the PREDICTED action, and check whether that sibling's indexed evidence pair is present in the erring item's pool but not indexed to the target slot.
error_mechanism_test.interpretation: Every resolvable dev error is distractor capture: the controller read a sentence that was present in the item but indexed to a different slot. This is precisely the failure mode the component design isolates, so the instrument is measuring what it was built to measure.
